pins.name: VCC(A)
pins.notes: Port A supply 0.8-5.5 V; only sets the port A input reference and power-good detect (p6); decoupling capacitor required (p12 Note 2). Requires 0.4 x VCC(A) + 0.8 V <= VCC(B).

pins.name: SCLA
pins.notes: Serial clock port A bus; open-drain, 5.5 V tolerant, high-Z when unpowered; each side needs a pullup (p6). Port A drives a hard LOW (no offset); may connect to port A of other PCA9617As (star) or to any static-offset buffer (p1).

pins.name: SDAA
pins.notes: Serial data port A bus; same as SCLA.

pins.name: EN
pins.notes: Active HIGH repeater enable, thresholds referenced to VCC(B), internal pullup to VCC(B) keeps the device active (p6). Change state only when the bus is idle.

pins.name: SDAB
pins.notes: Serial data port B bus; static offset LOW about 0.55 V; must not face port B of another PCA9617A or another static/incremented-offset buffer (p1). Devices on port B must pull below 0.4 V to be passed through (p7). Pullup must give IOL >= 150 uA (p11); B-side RC must be >= 67.5 ns (p6).

pins.name: SCLB
pins.notes: Serial clock port B bus; same as SDAB.

pins.name: VCC(B)
pins.notes: Port B supply 2.2-5.5 V; powers the logic and all I/Os (p6). Drivers off until VCC(B) > 2.2 V plus ~400 us settling (p6).

external_components.role: VCC(B) decoupling capacitor, 0.1 uF located near the VCC(B) pin
